kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تعتذرون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَذِرُونَ (taʕtaḏirūna) /taʕ.ta.ði.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# تُعْتَذَرُونَ (tuʕtaḏarūna) /tuʕ.ta.ða.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
